address: Rua Iguatemi s/n, São Paulo, 01451-010, Brazil
bio: This unique section of the city is home to the super-modern Pátio Malzoni alongside the Casa Bandeirista, an example of 17C Brazilian colonial architecture. Amid these contrasts, you’ll also find this exquisite trattoria paying homage to Southern Italy with its decor combining wood, leather and the flags of Italian football teams, plus a pleasant outdoor terrace. Here, the chef has created a menu featuring traditional recipes and dishes inspired by the region around Naples, including the island of Capri. The extensive choice includes the memorable linguine alle vongole with cherry tomatoes, the classic spaghetti alla carbonara, and the polpettone al forno (baked meatloaf), another excellent choice. Service is also a strong point here, so don’t hesitate to ask for a personal recommendation ...
